name: coss ui
notes: License: MIT for the apps/ui directory (the coss.com/ui library), declared in the monorepo root LICENSING.md: 'The following directory and their subdirectories are licensed under their original' MIT — apps/origin/ and apps/ui/. The monorepo default is AGPL-3.0 (root LICENSE); there is no separate LICENSE file inside apps/ui itself, the root LICENSING.md is the authority. Components are free to vendor.

coss.com/ui is the successor to Origin UI (originui.com redirects to coss.com; origin-space/originui redirects to cosscom/coss); the legacy Origin UI snapshot lives at apps/origin in the same monorepo. This catalog covers the NEW library at apps/ui.

Registry pattern verified: https://coss.com/ui/r/<name>.json returns shadcn registry-item JSON (HTTP 200, application/json) with files[].content — verified with accordion, p-accordion-1, use-media-query. The @coss/<name> namespace is an officially indexed shadcn registry (ui.shadcn.com/r/registries.json lists @coss -> https://coss.com/ui/r/{name}.json).

Documented set = every page under coss.com/ui sitemap (66 URLs): 55 component pages (docs/components/*), 2 hook pages (docs/hooks/use-media-query, use-copy-to-clipboard), the /particles gallery, and 8 guides/landing pages. Categories 'Components', 'Hooks', 'Particles' are the library's own docs sections (content/docs/*/meta.json titles).

Particles (508, registry items named p-*) are individually documented on https://coss.com/ui/particles — each card shows its description and install command (npx shadcn@latest add @coss/p-<family>-<n>). They share that single gallery URL; names/descriptions are taken verbatim from the registry JSON.

Gaps/nuances: (1) 'date-picker' has a docs page but no standalone registry item — its docs install via `npx shadcn@latest add @coss/calendar @coss/popover @coss/button`. (2) 'sidebar' exists as a registry item (@coss/sidebar, part of the @coss/ui and @coss/style bundles) but has no dedicated docs page, so it is not in this list. (3) Registry-only infrastructure items not documented as components: style, colors-neutral, fonts, font-sans, font-heading, font-mono, utils, merge-props, csp-provider, direction-provider, use-render. (4) Whole-library installs: `npx shadcn@latest add @coss/ui` (all 54 primitives) and `npx shadcn@latest init @coss/style` (full theme: colors, sidebar variables, fonts).
